purpose: Airline name normalization for the WhatsApp flight tracker

source_priority: Ben Gurion Airport official airline list

notes: The official Ben Gurion list is the primary source for airport-facing names.
IATA designators should be verified against the flight board before final deployment.
Some IAA entries are duplicate operating entities or seasonal/charter carriers; the bot should preserve aliases but deduplicate display names.
The list intentionally includes both Israel-relevant airlines and globally common airlines that may appear in user input even when not currently operating a Ben Gurion route.
Worldwide expansion added 947 active airlines with assigned two-letter IATA codes from OpenFlights.
Source snapshot: OpenFlights airlines.dat, downloaded during generation; the source marks activity with Y but notes that its active field is not perfectly reliable.
New global entries use aliases_he: [] unless a reliable Hebrew alias was already present in the submitted list, while preserving the original record schema.
The original submitted entries were preserved, including legacy duplicates and existing aliases, so downstream matching behavior remains compatible.
